faqs.question: Varo 和传统 npm 组件库有什么不同？
faqs.answer: Varo 默认通过 Registry 把组件与 Blocks 源码安装到业务项目中，团队可以直接修改并拥有这些源码。

faqs.question: Varo 支持哪些运行时？
faqs.answer: H5 使用 Vue 3，小程序使用 Wevu 与 weapp-vite；两端共享类型、纯函数和 headless primitives。

en.name: Varo
en.tagline: Registry-first mobile UI for two runtimes
en.description: Varo delivers editable component source, business Blocks, and Agent UI to H5 and Wevu mini-program projects through its Registry while preserving native rendering on each target.
en.audience: Vue 3 teams that need shared interaction semantics, component source, and business blocks across H5 and mini-program products.
useCases: Install editable H5 or mini-program component source from the Registry
Reuse dual-target business Blocks and Agent UI
Build a design system on headless primitives and theme tokens

faqs.question: How is Varo different from a traditional npm UI library?
faqs.answer: Varo uses its Registry to install component and Block source into the product repository by default, so teams can modify and own that source.

faqs.question: Which runtimes does Varo support?
faqs.answer: H5 uses Vue 3, while mini-program projects use Wevu and weapp-vite. The targets share types, pure functions, and headless primitives.
